ideas.title: The Impact of Minnesota's Feeding Our Future Fraud on Local Communities
ideas.description: An in-depth look at how the alleged $5.6 million fraud affected local communities and what it reveals about program oversight.
questions: How did the alleged fraud affect local food banks?
What oversight failures allowed the fraud to occur?
ideas.insight: This story could shed light on the human impact of the alleged fraud and what changes can be made to prevent similar incidents.
